title: Just Juice  Bar Saltfill Pineapple Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Bar Range Pineapple Saltfill delivers the tropical, juicy sweetness of freshly cut pineapples for a bright and refreshing vaping experience. This e-liquid offers a burst of sweet and tangy pineapple flavour that is perfect for fans of tropical fruit blends. The 40ml Saltfill bottle leaves space for one or two nicotine shots, allowing you to adjust the nicotine content to your liking. The Bar Range Saltfill is perfect for vapers who prefer pod devices and custom nicotine levels. With a 60PG/40VG ratio, this e-liquid is designed for low-powered MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices and pod systems. Simply add one or two 10ml 20mg nicotine shots to your Saltfill bottle and shake well. The final e-liquid provides a well-balanced flavour and vapour production, perfect for low-powered devices and pod systems. To make 50ml of 3.3mg e-liquid: Add one 10ml 20mg nicotine shot. To make 60ml of 6.6mg e-liquid: Add two 10ml 20mg nicotine shots. For a nicotine-free option, top up with PG/VG base Mix . The Just Juice Bar Range takes the flavours you love from disposable vapes and transforms them into a more versatile and long-lasting format. Perfect for those who enjoy intense, satisfying fruit flavours. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
